title: Bold Dome Huggies
category: Earrings (chunky domed hinged hoops, sold as 1 pair)
metal: 18k gold tone (listing: PVD 18K gold coating; base metal not stated), high mirror polish, warm saturated yellow; no brushing, no texture
lock: 1 pair, 2 hoops, 0 stones. Each hoop 16 mm across: 1 smooth crescent dome, round in section, about 4 mm thick at the bottom, tapering to 2 rounded end caps at the top; 1 slim hinged snap wire (about 1 mm) spans the top gap, with 1 small round knob at one end; 1 hairline seam at about 5 o'clock. Mirror-polished warm 18k gold tone. Must stay a 16 mm tapered dome hugging the lobe, never a bigger hoop or an even tube.
morph: Scale and taper, together. Image models blow it up into a 20-30 mm hoop that hangs below the lobe like a statement hoop (the performance worn ads read about 20 mm; the listing's own worn photo 04 reads about 1.8x true size; tight macros with no referent read big, silk ads) and even out the crescent into a uniform round tube or thin it into a wire hoop. Second risk: the slim hinge wire across the top gets lost, so the C closes into a solid ring or doughnut; or ribs, twists, hammering or stones get added to the plain dome.
sizeMm: Approximately 16 mm across, give or take 1 mm (listing description + size-guide photo 06). Measured on 06 against its own 10 mm ruler: about 15.6 mm wide x 16.7 mm tall, opening about 9 mm, wall about 3.3 mm at the sides and about 4 mm at the bottom, tapering to about 2 mm end caps; hinge wire about 1 mm. Referents: about 1.25 times the length of the green cardamom pod in 05; a little smaller than a 1-rupee coin (20 mm); worn, it should span roughly a quarter of the ear's height and sit close under the lobe (04 wrongly shows about half the ear height).

claimsNote: Tags are Earrings, Edition One, KAVNAR, pre-order: no Waterproof, Tarnish Free or Hypoallergenic tag. The description's 'anti-tarnish', 'stands up to sweat' and 'keeps its colour much longer' are not tag-backed, so no durability or skin claim in ads.
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, 18k gold tone, stock 23 (inventory policy DENY), tagged pre-order. Every product photo shows this tone; there is no rhodium silver tone option. Show the pair (packshot ref) or a single hoop worn on the lower lobe.
story: One confident shape and nothing else: no stones, no texture, a fat crescent of mirror gold that swells at the bottom and slims to a hairline hinge at the top, so front-on it looks bold and in profile it tucks close under the lobe. The polish works like a tiny 16 mm convex mirror, it catches the light along its whole curve and reflects whatever room she is in. The hinged snap clicks shut, a sound hook for video (ASMR click, close-up on the lobe). Rs 999 against a Rs 1,429 compare-at, on pre-order. It rhymes with: ghungroo bells (the brand study's own colour rhyme, and ad 68 'Ghungroo, on mute'), ring fryums (the 8.5-rated story ad: the hoop is about 3/4 of a fryum), a medu vada or a Polo mint (fat golden ring with a hole), a shrunken gold kada, a polished brass lota or katori rim, a crescent moon (the taper is literally a crescent: Eid chand, Karva Chauth moon), a pair of parentheses ( ) bracketing a word, a drop of honey or ghee catching light, a pencil it can close around (earlier PLAY ad). Wear-it moments from the listing: hair tucked back, alone, or with a small stud in a second piercing; morning to evening. Learned the hard way: two apricot halves with a hoop each read as a bosom (taste risk), and no-referent macros or worn renders oversize it.
copyNotes: Use: dome, full rounded dome, plain polished, mirror polish, catches the light along its whole curve, 16 mm across, hinged snap, clicks shut, close to the lobe, 18k gold tone, PVD 18k gold tone, no stones, one confident shape, morning to evening, pre-order, Rs 999. Avoid: 'huggie'/'huggies' in body copy (an Indian nappy brand; the product title is the only exception), 'gold', '18k gold' or 'solid gold' without 'tone' (the macro alt text says 'Solid mid-weight yellow gold huggie hoop': never repeat it), 'anti-tarnish', 'tarnish free', 'waterproof', 'sweat-proof', 'hypoallergenic', 'keeps its colour' (no claim tags), 'stainless steel' or any base metal (not in the listing), '14 mm' (stale Edition One lock) or any size other than 16 mm, 'Rs 1,649' (stale Edition One price), 'large', 'statement hoop', 'dangling', 'brushed', 'textured', 'twisted', any stone word (CZ, crystal, diamond, zircon), 'silver', ship-today or in-stock promises (it is pre-order).

photos.shows: Macro: 1 hoop standing in 3/4 view on a cream ground. Best construction detail: the crescent dome thick at the bottom and tapering up, the slim hinge wire across the top gap, a small round knob on the right end cap, the inner channel, a hairline seam low right. 18k gold tone, mirror polish. Fills the frame, so it reads huge: no scale. Earlier media id a095b727-9779-41b9-9716-c0a555e7357d.

Packshot: the pair on a white plaster cube, cream backdrop. Left hoop front-on (full C, hinge wire across the top, seam at about 5 o'clock); right hoop turned 3/4 to show the dome's depth and inner channel. 18k gold tone. Reference 1 (media id c524c1be-2144-468d-9f0d-2381e9bc5fac).
Packaging: the blush NAIRA gift box on a wet white surface. No product.

Worn: model in a mustard satin cami, hand at her chin, 1 hoop on the lobe in 3/4 profile. 18k gold tone. Construction right, scale wrong: the hoop is about half the ear's height (about 160 px vs about 325 px ear), about 28-30 mm, roughly 1.8x true size, and it hangs below the lobe. The listing alt text says 'shown at true size' but it is not: a listing fix to flag, and never a scale reference.

Scale: the pair lying flat and overlapping on blush plaster, a green cardamom pod resting on the back hoop. The hoop is about 1.25 pod lengths, consistent with 16 mm. Knobs, seams and the taper all visible. 18k gold tone. Reference 2 (new media id da442fe7-6098-4da9-afb8-a2108bfaeebb).
Size guide: the packshot with a 16 mm bar and a 10 mm ruler, 'Hoop 16 mm across, measurements are approximate, give or take 1 mm'. Scale evidence; text overlay, so not a generation reference.
